description: Alpha Agent Stage 9 - persistent Autonomous Alpha Tournament. A disciplined candidate-selection system that continuously generates, evaluates, ranks, rejects, combines and forward-monitors alpha candidates on top of the Stage 5 experiment engine, the Stage 8 durable queue and the forward-prediction immutable snapshot store. RESEARCH ONLY. There is NO automatic PROMOTED state; READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW never modifies the operating model. Never creates orders/fills/signals/trade-decisions/model-promotions/Alpha-Paper-Book changes/Daily-Close/PostgreSQL writes; never runs the prediction service. A candidate is NEVER ranked highly merely because one isolated metric or one test period looks good.

evidence_completeness.note: A candidate can only be REJECTED on complete-and-weak evidence. When coverage/observation/PIT minimums are unmet the candidate is DATA_HOLD (evidence cannot yet be evaluated honestly), never REJECTED.

gates.note: KEEP_FOR_RESEARCH requires ALL of the following on COMPLETE evidence. Complete-but-failing => REJECTED with the specific failed gate. Thresholds are deliberately explicit and versioned; none are invented silently at runtime.

manual_review_gate.note: READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW is the strongest state and still NEVER changes the operating model. It requires historical evidence pass + robustness pass + demonstrable added value beyond the champion and retained candidates + a shadow book with enough true-forward observations + all caveats displayed.

scoring.note: Combined tournament score in [0,1], reproducible and decomposable into six sub-scores. A candidate with excellent gross return but poor cost-adjusted performance or instability CANNOT lead: cost and stability are weighted and a hard cost/stability penalty caps the combined score.

cost.note: cost sub-score falls as cost erodes gross; net25<=0 forces cost sub-score to 0 and caps combined score.

diversification.note: diversification sub-score = 1 - max(|corr vs champion|, |corr vs retained|). High correlation is penalized so a redundant candidate cannot lead.

forward_evidence.note: 0 until a shadow book exists; grows with true-forward observations toward maturity and rewards realized net outperformance.

auto_experiments.note: The tournament autonomously enqueues the next highest-value experiments into the Stage 8 durable queue. Bounded per cycle, deterministically deduplicated by experiment specification hash. Each strategy addresses a real next question; endless re-optimization against one historical sample is forbidden.

shadow_books.note: Read-only research shadow books for the strongest KEEP_FOR_RESEARCH candidates, built on the forward-prediction immutable first-write-wins snapshot store. Never mutate the operating portfolio; never backfill forward history before the shadow book's inception date.
shadow_books.allowlist_note: Stage 26: shadow activation is FAIL-CLOSED. The combined score is a weighted aggregate and can clear the floor while the candidate's own falsification battery returned a damning verdict - s24_rnd_intensity scores 0.674 and is CONCENTRATION_FRAGILE. A candidate is enrolled only when the caller names it forward-eligible on stated evidence, so a shadow book that begins accumulating irreversible forward history is never started by accident.
shadow_books.label: RESEARCH SHADOW BOOK - NOT THE OPERATING PORTFOLIO

cycle.note: Per-production-cycle bounded tournament tick integrated into the AlphaAgent-Collect autonomy cycle. Resumable after Windows/process restart; leaves useful future work queued while unresolved candidates remain.

reporting.note: Morning and post-close reports flag ONLY meaningful tournament changes; unchanged leaderboards are never re-sent.

stage9_4.note: Stage 9.4 orthogonal-discovery capabilities the AGENT drives autonomously from its canonical collect tick. When seed_price_catalogue is true the tick idempotently seeds the pre-registered price-factor catalogue; when evaluate_price_catalogue is true the owned-price campaign also computes the NEW factors and enriches each with orthogonality / regime / walk-forward / bootstrap / selection-bias evidence before classify_evidence decides DATA_HOLD/REJECTED/KEEP. No gate is lowered; the INDEPENDENT_INFORMATION sub-score is reported in the decomposition and folded into the combined score only via scoring.weights.independent_information (default absent = 0, operator-tunable).

followups.note: Stage 9.4 release closure: the AGENT autonomously enqueues a BOUNDED, pre-registered price-factor REVALIDATION experiment (a genuine canonical CAT_EXPERIMENT job on the shared durable queue, origin stage9-tournament, lane tournament.stage9_4_revalidation) each cycle, so the generate->claim->execute->persist->ingest loop closes through the production handler even with zero retained candidates. Deterministic, spec-deduplicated and capped: at most max_per_cycle NEW jobs, targeting ONLY computable owned-price catalogue candidates already on COMPLETE evidence (REJECTED), re-running the candidate's OWN registered horizon (a reproduction, not a parameter search). No gate is lowered; no KEEP is forced; nothing operational is mutated. Disabled by default in offline/acceptance configs.

companyfacts_campaign.note: Stage 9.4 release closure DECISION = OPTION B (DEFER HONESTLY). SUPERSEDED BY stage9_5 (Option A now ACTIVE): the live, bounded per-CIK SEC companyfacts acquisition + fundamental activation is wired under the stage9_5 block and configs/alpha_agent/stage8_autonomy.json autonomy.collect_drain.companyfacts_continuation. This Stage 9.4 block is retained only as the historical deferral record; the live acquisition path is governed entirely by stage9_5. Leaving enabled=false here is intentional (this block no longer gates anything - stage9_5.enabled + companyfacts_continuation.enabled do).

final_holdout.note: A single reserved final out-of-sample window that can be consumed at most once - never re-mined across cycles.
final_holdout.description: reserved final holdout - single-use selection-bias guard

stage9_5.note: Stage 9.5 RELEASE CLOSURE explicitly SPLITS the stage: 9.5A = current-universe SEC companyfacts ACQUISITION (release-ready, keeps collecting); 9.5B = survivorship-safe HISTORICAL fundamental EVALUATION (BLOCKED until an owned historical ticker->CIK mapping + per-rebalance readiness both pass). The AlphaAgent autonomously drives a BOUNDED, restart-safe SEC companyfacts DATA_ACQUISITION campaign (reusing the proven sec_edgar collector's companyfacts lane, the content-addressed immutable RawArchive, the durable CampaignStore cursor and the existing collect-cycle drain) and materializes leakage-safe per-(CIK,concept,fiscal-period) PIT observations (availability = SEC filed date; restatements preserved; no future-restatement look-ahead). The current company_tickers.json map is CURRENT-ONLY, so the current constituents are NOT a valid historical backtest universe; until an owned survivorship-safe historical mapping exists the collected facts are ACQUISITION / forward-evidence ONLY and NO historical fundamental experiment is generated (release-model OPTION B). No gate is lowered; coverage alone never promotes a candidate; a fundamental candidate stays DATA_HOLD (an honest all-DATA_HOLD outcome is acceptable). Nothing operational is mutated; no automatic promotion or champion replacement.

release_model.stage_9_5a_acquisition: current-universe SEC companyfacts acquisition - RELEASE-READY (may continue collecting the current SEC universe independently)
release_model.stage_9_5b_historical_evaluation: survivorship-safe historical fundamental evaluation - BLOCKED until historical ticker->CIK mapping + per-rebalance readiness both pass
release_model.next_stage: build an owned survivorship-safe historical security-to-CIK mapping (Norgate historical identifiers + membership history + SEC former-name metadata) with effective start/end dates, ticker-reuse and delisting distinction, a mapping-version hash and an explicit ambiguous/unmapped backlog

historical_universe.note: Owned survivorship-safe HISTORICAL ticker->CIK mapping status. Stage 10: mapping availability + per-rebalance readiness are now derived from the MEASURED identity store at identity_store_db (append-only coverage snapshots), NOT from the mapping_available flag below. The flag remains false and is NOT read as the primary source; it stays only as a hard OFF backstop. The measured historical mapping coverage over the FULL survivorship-safe universe (current + delisted) must reach min_historical_mapping_coverage_pct before the gate unlocks - aggregate current-CIK coverage can never satisfy that denominator, so the diagnostic stays honest until genuine historical coverage exists. Claude never flips the switch; the AlphaAgent's identity coverage/readiness jobs measure it.
historical_universe.companyfacts_index_note: Stage 10.2: the durable bulk SEC companyfacts fact index the measured per-rebalance PIT readiness is built from (fundamental_readiness.open_companyfacts_pit_store). Present here only so the tournament-side readiness/gate can locate the owned index; it is populated by the AlphaAgent's Stage 10.2 campaign, never hand-edited.

per_rebalance_readiness.note: PER-DATE historical readiness thresholds (replaces aggregate-CIK-only readiness). A fundamental candidate is eligible ONLY when EVERY threshold passes on the survivorship-safe universe as it stood on each historical rebalance date AND a historical mapping is available. Current-universe aggregate counts alone never mark a candidate sufficient.

companyfacts_campaign.note: The dedicated live companyfacts campaign. Acquisition bounds (batch size, daily cap, no-progress stop) are enforced INLINE by the runtime companyfacts handler from the durable append-only campaign_batch log and are configured in configs/alpha_agent/stage8_autonomy.json (autonomy.collect_drain.companyfacts_continuation). This block records the concept scope and the fundamental readiness thresholds the tournament side uses.

fundamental_experiments.note: Stage 9.5B / 10.2 historical fundamental EXPERIMENT generation. The production handler is implemented and gated by the SAFETY SWITCH. Stage 10.2 REPLACES the old fixed Boolean-only switch with an explicit activation_mode: 'disabled' (the safe default and the reading of a missing/false historical_evaluation_enabled Boolean) can NEVER open; 'measured_auto' opens the gate AUTOMATICALLY and ONLY when the MEASURED identity mapping coverage AND the MEASURED per-rebalance PIT readiness (built from the owned bulk companyfacts index) BOTH pass on the survivorship-safe historical universe. In measured_auto mode the deprecated historical_evaluation_enabled Boolean stays false and is NEVER read as the primary source or hand-flipped - the AlphaAgent's measured Stage 10.2 coverage/readiness jobs open it. When open, generate_stage9_5_fundamental_followups enqueues a bounded, spec-deduplicated CAT_EXPERIMENT (origin stage9-tournament, lane tournament.stage9_5_fundamental) that evaluates a genuine cross-sectional Stage 9 evidence contract (rank-IC, TRUE decile spread, cost/turnover, forward-only purged validation, block bootstrap, orthogonality) imported exactly once. No gate is ever lowered; an honest all-DATA_HOLD outcome is acceptable.
